patterns.message: Production source must not depend on tests, repository tooling, generated output, or architecture probes.
Database frameworks, worker runtimes, queues, and API transports are outside revo-run.
MCP transport and server dependencies belong to the host, not revo-run.
Orchestrator packages are hosts of revo-run and must never be dependencies.
Agent and script runtimes belong behind injected executor adapters, not in revo-run core.
canonicalize is restricted to the canonical JSON policy implementation.
node:crypto is restricted to canonical JSON digest implementation.
